items.title: India’s Namma Yatri Model Heads to Europe: MTI Brings Open Mobility to Global Cities

evidence.text: MTI takes its India-built open mobility model to the World Economic Forum in Geneva.Moving Tech Innovations (MTI), the Bengaluru-based company behind Namma Yatri, whose platforms have facilitated close to 200 million trips in India with drivers paying zero commission, plans to help major European cities build open, sovereign mobility infrastructure.

items.title: Circle Raises Rs 25 Crore Led By Nexus Venture Partners, To Build India’s Trusted AI‑Driven Pre‑Owned Marketplace

evidence.text: In just a year since launch, Circle has facilitated about ₹25 crore in pre-owned sales, attracting over 1 million visitors and generating 100,000 listings from Bengaluru alone. On Circle, sellers typically find a buyer within three days, while listings on classifieds can take weeks or even months to sell. Circle is bringing much-needed liquidity and trust to a market that has long lacked both.

items.title: GE Aerospace Announces Plans to Nearly Double Supplier Spend In-Country to Help Meet India’s Aviation Industry Growth

evidence.text: "India’s commercial aviation growth is one of the fastest in the world, and today’s report shows that our commitment here goes far beyond selling engines," said Vikram Rai, CEO, South Asia, GE Aerospace. "It's in the components machined in Pune, the innovation in Bengaluru, and our trusted customers, who are building the next generation of India's aerospace industry. As India works towards its Viksit Bharat ambitions, doubling our spend to grow the supply chain ecosystem will help meet the growing demand."

items.title: Bengaluru-based Peptris Technologies Gets ₹86 Cr Financial Support Under the RDI Fund of TDB-DST

evidence.text: India has taken a decisive step toward transforming its pharmaceutical innovation ecosystem. The Technology Development Board (TDB) under the Department of Science & Technology (DST) has signed an agreement with Peptris Technologies Pvt. Ltd., Bengaluru, to provide ₹86 crore in financial support under the Research Development and Innovation (RDI) Fund. This investment will accelerate the VIGOR programme, which aims to advance four AI-discovered drug candidates from Technology Readiness Level (TRL)-4 to TRL-6, moving them closer to clinical development.

items.title: Bengaluru to Host One of India’s Largest Climate-Data Gatherings as Bangalore Climate Data Week 2026 Brings 30+ Events Together

evidence.text: The first edition of Bangalore Climate Data Week (BLR-CDW) 2026 will be a city-wide platform focused on accelerating the implementation of data and AI to help solve real-world climate challenges. The week-long convening will be held from the 12th to the 16th of October 2026 with 30+ partner-led events hosted across Bengaluru. This is an initiative by the Climate Collective Foundation (CCF), convened in association with Google as Anchor Partner and Karnataka Digital Economy Mission (KDEM), Karnataka Innovation and Technology Society (KITS), and Startup Karnataka as State Innovation Partners.

items.title: Eloelo Group Unveils Dolphin AI, an Agentic AI Studio Revolutionizing Multi‑Shot Video Production for Creators Worldwide

evidence.text: About Eloelo GroupEloelo Group is an entertainment and technology company headquartered in Bengaluru, building a portfolio of consumer internet and AI products. Its flagship product, Story TV, is a premium vertical storytelling platform that crossed 120 million users in its first year, with more than 5,000 original titles and audiences spending over 100 minutes a day on the platform. Besides Story TV, Eloelo Group’s portfolio spans entertainment, learning and AI, including Master for micro-learning and Dolphin AI.

items.title: Arma Capital Invests ₹10 Crore Across EBG Group’s Wellness, Food and Family Businesses

evidence.text: Maharashtra-based Arma Capital has invested ₹10 crore across EBG Group’s wellness, food and family businesses, marking its entry into multiple consumer-facing brands under the Hyderabad-headquartered business group. The investment includes Carlton Wellness Centres in Mumbai, Bengaluru and Chandigarh, along with franchise partnerships for NATUF Café, Adhira & Appa Café and Chhota Bheem Family Café in Hyderabad.
